import re,html,json,pathlib
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
t=pathlib.Path('products/services/first-receipt/raw/forhire-new.rss').read_text()
ns={'a':'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}
r=ET.fromstring(t)
out=[]
for e in r.findall('a:entry',ns):
  ti=e.findtext('a:title','',ns); 
  if 'hiring' not in ti.lower(): continue
  c=html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',html.unescape(e.findtext('a:content','',ns))))
  c=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',c)
  out.append({'title':ti,'updated':e.findtext('a:updated','',ns),'link':e.find('a:link',ns).get('href'),'text':c[:700]})
p=pathlib.Path('products/services/first-receipt/forhire-hiring-extract.json');p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
print(len(out))
for o in out: print(o['updated'],o['title'],'|',o['text'][:300],'\n')
